Interface GameStateRenderer

All Known Implementing Classes:
BoardRenderer
public interface GameStateRenderer
Renders the game state to the console. Keeping the rendering behind this interface lets ClientStateListenerCli delegate presentation instead of owning it (which would violate the single-responsibility principle).
